verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API with an explicit `GET /v1/experiments/{id}/results` endpoint for pulling the latest analysis. It also ships an official MCP server that lets AI tools like Claude make authenticated REST calls guided by Agent Skills workflows. Results expose interpretable statistics such as Chance to Win, which supports ship/rollback reasoning. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented endpoint for reading experiment configuration (only implied by the 'full REST API' claim), a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), documented agent skills specifically for summarizing results or recommending ship/rollback, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
